verdict.reasoning: Garvit's native 'Cost/Access Arbitrage' hooks are unmatched for initial click-through and raw Indian audience relatability, but his scripts risk audience fatigue if limited to 'get X tool free'. Blending his punchy Hinglish hack openers with competitors' multi-step agency/automation frameworks (like Aryaman and Arshman) will boost authority and retention while preserving high comment-to-DM conversions.
verdict.recommended_hook_structure: [Stop doing standard action / Brand Name Drop] + [Cost/Time Arbitrage Metric] + [Visual Proof Reveal in under 3 seconds]. Example: 'Stop paying for [Tool] subscriptions. A developer just made this workflow 100% free, and it runs in 60 seconds.'
verdict.recommended_body_structure: Show visual proof immediately -> Name the free or open-source stack -> Break down the exact 3-step workflow (Input -> Agent/Tool -> Output) -> Quantify time or money saved.
verdict.recommended_cta_structure: Double-trigger CTA: 'Comment [SINGLE ACTION WORD] and I’ll DM you the exact template/workflow link directly.'
avoid_these: Vague motivational monologues without actionable tech takeaways or tool integrations
Promising tools that require hidden paid API keys without clearly stating it upfront
Blank captions; at least provide a keyword summary and a clear DM automation callout
